**Tesla Model S – India**

Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other Model S‑class vehicle) in India, so there is no official Indian pricing or availability at this time.

If you’re curious about what the price might look like, you can look at the U.S. launch price and convert it to Indian rupees:

| Region | Starting MSRP (USD) | Approx. INR (using 1 USD ≈ ₹82) |
|--------|---------------------|--------------------------------|
| United States | $90,000 (Base Model S) | ₹7.38 million |

> **Note:** This is a rough conversion and does not account for import duties, taxes, local incentives, or any price adjustments Tesla might make for the Indian market. Until Tesla officially announces a launch in India, the actual price could differ significantly.
